title: Stop committing the generated front-door-tools mirror; build it at publish time
problem: About 5,840 of gitops/'s 6,005 files are gitops/prod/front-door-tools, which platform/marketing/regen.mjs rewrites. Because it is committed, every venture change needs a manual 'regen.mjs --verify' step, and CLAUDE.md calls skipping it 'the most common way a venture fix ships to the venture page but not to the apex copy users see'. CAVEAT: filed from a one-pass repo-organization review (2026-10-16), not a measured study. The change is a first guess and may be oversimplified; check the evidence and the dependents before acting on it, and drop the item with a reason if it does not hold up.
evidence: git ls-files gitops | cut -d/ -f1-3 on origin/main 2029d18f86: 5,839 files under gitops/prod/front-door-tools
CLAUDE.md pre-merge checklist: regen.mjs --verify / regen.mjs lines and their note
change: Find every reader of the committed mirror first (platform/marketing/*.mjs and tests, portfolio-validate.yml, publish-branch.sh, the gh-pages publish). If they can all build it on demand, generate it in publish-branch.sh / CI and gitignore it. If some reader needs it committed (e.g. a diffable record of what was served), keep it and drop this item.
metric: Files under gitops/prod/front-door-tools in git; merges that later needed a regen-only fix commit
source: Repo-organization review in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-16 (unmeasured; see CAVEAT in problem)
